questions.executed_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clients_factures_2025_pas_2026 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)) AS t

WITH rev AS (SELECT s.customer_region AS region, s.customer_id, SUM(s.net_revenue) AS net_revenue FROM analytics.sales_lines AS s WHERE s.invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND s.invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY s.customer_region, s.customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT r.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY r.net_revenue DESC) AS rk FROM rev AS r) SELECT k.region, k.customer_id, c.customer_name, ROUND(k.net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue_2025 FROM ranked AS k JOIN analytics.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id WHERE k.rk = 1 ORDER BY net_revenue_2025 DESC

WITH q AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS quarter_start, SUM(net_revenue) AS rev FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT quarter_start, rev, LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start) AS prev_rev FROM q) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM quarter_start) AS INT) AS year, CAST(EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM quarter_start) AS INT) AS quarter, ROUND(rev, 2) AS net_revenue, ROUND(prev_rev, 2) AS previous_quarter_net_revenue, ROUND(100 * (rev - prev_rev) / NULLIF(prev_rev, 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM g WHERE quarter_start >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY quarter_start

questions.executed_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(net_revenue) AS rev FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY customer_id), t AS (SELECT rev FROM c ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT ROUND((SELECT SUM(rev) FROM t), 2) AS ca_net_top20, ROUND((SELECT SUM(rev) FROM c), 2) AS ca_net_total_2025, ROUND((SELECT SUM(rev) FROM t) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(rev) FROM c), 0), 4) AS part_top20

questions.executed_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS mois, SUM(net_revenue) AS ca FROM analytics.sales_lines WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2024-12-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT mois, ca, ca - LAG(ca) OVER (ORDER BY mois) AS hausse FROM m) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mois) AS INT) AS numero_mois, ROUND(ca, 2) AS chiffre_affaires_net, ROUND(hausse, 2) AS hausse_vs_mois_precedent FROM d WHERE mois >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND hausse IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hausse DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS clients_sans_facture_en_retard, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.customers AS c2 WHERE c2.segment = c.segment) AS clients_total FROM analytics.customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM analytics.invoices AS i WHERE i.customer_id = c.customer_id AND i.is_overdue) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS settled_invoices, ROUND(CAST(AVG(i.days_paid_late) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_days_paid_late FROM analytics.invoices AS i JOIN analytics.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.is_settled AND i.invoice_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date <= CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY average_days_paid_late DESC
